baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural gardens at word 2 and the reciprocal verb at word 3 jointly anchor a situated, plural exchange.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tree-covered enclosures supply a cultivated setting, while reciprocal questioning makes the people within it active interlocutors rather than passive occupants.

activation_trace.role: The tree-covered garden supplies the enclosed, cultivated setting for the exchange.
Reciprocal questioning supplies a plural exchange in which participants ask one another.

changed_reading.before: A flat locative gloss: they are in gardens and ask questions.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a council-like exchange inside multiple tree-covered enclosures: the inhabitants actively question one another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cover and protection branches of the garden root remain attached to word 2, and the reciprocal asking branch remains attached to word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Concealment and protection define the spatial condition; mutual asking can then function as a way of approaching matters that are not immediately visible.

activation_trace.role: Covering from perception supplies a sheltered boundary and a field of initially hidden matter.
Protective cover makes the enclosure a condition of safety rather than mere visual concealment.
Reciprocal asking turns the protected enclosure into a site of shared disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are scenery and the asking is unspecified conversation.
changed_reading.after: They speak from within protective cover, using mutual questions to bring what is not immediately visible into shared view.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens with an outer covering, names concealment of truth, removes a cover at dawn, and closes with prevention of harm and the covering of sin. Within that sequence, the focus garden is revised from mere hiddenness into a protective cover compatible with unveiling rather than denial.

activation_trace.role: The focus garden contributes the shared image of covering whose moral function is being differentiated.
The protective-cover branch places the garden on the preserving side of the contrast.
Active reciprocal speech prevents the positive cover from reading as inert withdrawal.
The outer wrap supplies the surah's initial, morally undecided form of covering.
Concealing truth supplies the negative use of covering against which the garden is distinguished.
Removing a cover supplies the revelatory reversal immediately before the focus scene.
Preventing harm supplies the positive protective function assigned to the garden-cover.
Covering sin while preserving its bearer supplies the closing reparative form of cover.

structural_cues: The sequence distributes wrapping at 74:1, uncovering at 74:34, garden-cover at 74:40, and protective forgiveness at 74:56 across the whole surah.
The plural reciprocal verb in 74:40 makes the protected condition communicative rather than dormant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated branch images of covering, uncovering, protection, and forgiveness; I infer a moral contrast among kinds of cover and assign the garden the protective pole. A live alternative is that the repetitions are independent and the garden remains only botanical.

changed_reading.before: The garden is a sheltered setting with no further contrastive force.
changed_reading.after: The garden is the surah's positive cover: protection after unveiling, unlike the cover that hides truth, and a place where protected people can speak openly.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier solitary figure cycles through thought and calculation before uttering a label of deceptive, transmitted speech. The reciprocal morphology of the focus verb now forms a counter-practice: inquiry distributed among speakers and followed by an answer rather than a calculated label imposed by one speaker.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies the dialogic form that counters the earlier solitary speech sequence.
The heart's repeated circulation over a matter supplies the inward, solitary phase of the contrasting speech process.
Arranging an affair by estimation supplies the calculated construction of the eventual label.
Uttering a statement externalizes the result of that private calculation.
Diversion and deception supply the dismissive category imposed on the message.
A report transmitted until it becomes inherited supplies the claim used to deny fresh address.

structural_cues: 74:18-24 uses a chain of singular verbs ending in a verdict, while 74:40-43 shifts to reciprocal plural questioning and a plural reply.
The focus verb encodes mutual participation rather than a one-way declaration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed speech sequences; I infer that the later reciprocal inquiry repairs the earlier calculated labeling by eliciting accountable speech. Alternatively, the scenes may contrast truth and falsehood without making the questioning a formal counter-practice.

changed_reading.after: Their mutual questioning is a counter-form of speech: it replaces solitary calculated labeling with participatory inquiry that lets an account answer back.

context_deltas.mechanism: Each individual self is presented as held security for what it acquired; an exception then becomes a company identified by the right side, and that company appears in the focus as a protected questioning plurality. The scene therefore moves from individual custody to corporate, dialogic freedom.

activation_trace.role: Protective cover supplies the condition occupied by the excepted company.
Reciprocal questioning supplies the free social activity that follows the exception.
The self as the thing itself supplies the individually accountable unit.
Acquiring gain supplies what attaches liability to each self.
A document or object held as security supplies the custody model from which the exception departs.
Companionship and sustained association convert exceptional individuals into a social body.
The right hand or rightward side supplies the identifying side-label of that company.

structural_cues: 74:38-40 moves from singular `each self`, through the exception `companions`, to the plural reciprocal verb.
The exception immediately governs the prepositional garden phrase and its plural activity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies individual pledge, exception, companionship, and protected plural speech; I infer that the exception functions as release into communal agency. A live alternative is that it marks status without depicting a temporal release from custody.

changed_reading.before: Unspecified inhabitants happen to ask one another in gardens.
changed_reading.after: A company exempted from individual pledge-custody exercises its freedom as a protected, questioning collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah supplies the inquiry's human target, and the following question asks what inserted those people into a destination. The focus reciprocity thus opens a causal investigation of route and entry, not merely a request to identify occupants.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies the investigative speech frame.
Offense and culpability supply the class about whom the investigation turns.
Insertion of one thing into another supplies the directional entry whose causes the question probes.

structural_cues: The suspended focus verb is completed across 74:41-42 by `about the criminals` and the direct question `what inserted you into Saqar?`.
The paired `in gardens` and `in Saqar` phrases set opposed destinations around the act of questioning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a culpable target and an insertion question; I infer that the garden exchange reconstructs the trajectory into Saqar. The live narrower alternative is a question about only the immediate cause of arrival.

changed_reading.before: The reciprocal question has no specified object or purpose.
changed_reading.after: The protected company conducts a trajectory audit, asking how culpable people came to be inserted into the opposed destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The answer unfolds as an ordered first-person-plural account: absent worship, withheld feeding from the abased poor, immersion with other participants, denial of reckoning, and finally fixed certainty. Reciprocal asking becomes a structured disclosure of relational, social, participatory, and epistemic habits.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies the eliciting frame for the ordered self-account.
Specific worship supplies the first denied practice in the account.
Feeding another supplies the material-care relation that the speakers say they withheld.
Abasement and poverty specify the vulnerable condition of the unfed recipient.
Entering into discourse or an affair supplies the speakers' participatory immersion with a peer group.
Contradiction of truth supplies the epistemic refusal named by the speakers.
Reckoning and recompense supply the denied horizon that would have integrated the preceding practices.
Fixed knowledge with doubt removed supplies the terminal point of the confession.

structural_cues: The repeated `we were not` and `we used to` constructions in 74:43-46 organize the reply as habitual self-testimony.
The list crosses worship, care, association, and belief before its `until` endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered answer to the entry question; I infer that its items form a causal diagnostic matrix rather than disconnected recollections. A live alternative is that the list is representative testimony and not an exhaustive causal chain.

changed_reading.before: The gardeners ask generally how the other group arrived in Saqar.
changed_reading.after: Their questioning elicits a patterned confession in which failed worship, failed care, collective immersion, and denial jointly disclose a lived route to the destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the exchange, even the joining of an advocate to another yields no benefit. The focus dialogue is therefore bounded: protected speakers can question and receive testimony, but speech does not automatically attach the speakers' protected status to those questioned.

activation_trace.role: Protective cover supplies the status that the dialogue cannot simply transfer.
Reciprocal asking supplies a real social relation whose legal efficacy is then limited.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the explicitly denied effect of attempted mediation.
Joining an intercessor to another supplies the social attachment that fails to change the outcome.

structural_cues: The dialogue and confession occupy 74:40-47; the denial of beneficial intercession follows immediately in 74:48.
Questioning crosses the boundary between the two groups, but the paired destination phrases remain distinct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dialogue followed by failed beneficial joining; I infer that the dialogue functions as diagnosis or testimony rather than rescue. Alternatively, 74:48 may state a general consequence without specifying the function of the preceding questions.

changed_reading.before: Mutual questioning could be heard as an open-ended social contact that might aid those addressed.
changed_reading.after: The exchange crosses the boundary for testimony but not for transfer of protection: dialogue remains possible where rescue by social attachment is not.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the confession, the surah depicts turning aside, recoiling, and fleeing from the reminder, then repeats reminder and remembering. Read against that pattern, the focus questions enact the opposite motion: they make a refused history present and speakable.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies the social operation that calls an avoided account back into speech.
The reminder supplies the content from which the addressed group turns away.
Bringing something back to mind supplies the mnemonic function activated in the earlier dialogue.
Turning one's side away supplies the first bodily refusal of remembrance.
Recoiling and distancing supply an intensified refusal to remain before the reminder.
Flight supplies the completed outward motion that the questioning reverses.

structural_cues: 74:49-56 moves from aversion and flight to repeated reminder and remembering.
The first-person-plural reply in 74:43-47 makes previously resisted conduct verbally present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confession, flight from reminder, and repeated remembering language; I infer that the focus dialogue is a social recovery of refused memory. A live alternative is that the later flight addresses a different temporal audience, making the relation typological rather than sequential.

changed_reading.before: The questioning gathers information about another group's past.
changed_reading.after: The questioning is a mnemonic reversal of aversion and flight: it compels an avoided pattern of life to become present in communal speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant, form-distant mapping from the focus asking root to drawing and linkage branches. It remains anchored to focus word 3 and is activated by the following threading/insertion image; downstream prose should mark it as exploratory mechanism or wordplay, never as the lexical gloss of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 3 carries the packet-authorized mapped inventory for gentle extraction and chainlike connection, while retaining its ordinary reciprocal-questioning inventory.

activation_trace.role: Gentle hidden drawing-out supplies an exploratory image for eliciting an account from another speaker.
Chainlike connection supplies the ordered linkage among the elicited admissions.
Thread used for sewing supplies the contextual image that links the account to the question of entry.

changed_reading.before: They ask one another what happened.
changed_reading.after: They gently draw out a linked account, admission by admission, tracing the thread by which the respondents were inserted into Saqar.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because womb, fresh beginning, resurrection, and revival are branch-distant from the surface garden and from the local publication sense at 74:52. It remains anchored to branches of focus word 2 within an afterlife sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain spatial analogy, not as a lexical replacement or a claim of literal birth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus garden root includes both a fetus hidden in a womb and a fresh beginning, allowing the enclosure to carry a carefully contained renewal analogy.

activation_trace.role: The fetus hidden in a womb supplies the enclosed, gestational side of the analogy.
Fresh beginning supplies renewal rather than mere enclosure.
Reciprocal questioning makes renewed communal speech the enclosure's first visible activity.
Resurrection and rising of the Hour supply the remote renewal branch activated by the command to rise.
Reviving the dead supplies a second, explicitly contained renewal image from the spreading root.

changed_reading.before: The plural gardens are finished reward-spaces in which conversation occurs.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the gardens resemble gestational enclosures of renewed social life, with reciprocal speech as the first disclosed activity of that new beginning.

strongest_changes: The unspecified reciprocal exchange became a causal audit of what inserted culpable people into Saqar.
The ordered reply turned that audit into a social and ethical confession spanning worship, material care, peer participation, denial, and certainty.
The garden's covering shifted from botanical shelter to morally positive protection, contrasted with truth-concealment and completed by protection and forgiveness.
The exception from pledge-custody converted the plural speakers into a released companion body whose dialogue can elicit testimony but cannot transfer rescue.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet activated cover and uncover, monologue and dialogue, custody and release, and reminder and flight as functional contrasts around the two focus words. It also made the form-distant asking-to-linkage mapping worth preserving under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The covering sequence may be a productive branch resonance rather than a deliberate lexical chain.
The syntax leaves room over whether the garden inhabitants ask only one another about the criminals or also turn the quoted question directly toward them.
The confessional list may be representative rather than an exhaustive causal route.
The drawing and linkage reading depends on a non-dominant mapped root and must remain exploratory.
